LanguageData.LP_WS_FireBolt.label: fire bolt
LanguageData.LP_WS_FireBolt.description: Cantrip (Evocation): hurl fire at one enemy within 26 cells, 8 × arcane power fire damage with a 30% chance to ignite it. Cooldown 4 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_WS_RayOfFrost.label: ray of frost
LanguageData.LP_WS_RayOfFrost.description: Cantrip (Evocation): one enemy within 24 cells takes 6 × arcane power cold damage, movement ×0.6 for 3 seconds. Cooldown 4 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_WS_ShockingGrasp.label: shocking grasp
LanguageData.LP_WS_ShockingGrasp.description: Cantrip (Evocation): lightning flashes in your palm, a melee hit for 10 × arcane power lightning damage; mechanoids take EMP damage instead and are paralyzed for 1 second. Cooldown 3 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_WS_PoisonSpray.label: poison spray
LanguageData.LP_WS_PoisonSpray.description: Cantrip (Conjuration): spray poison at one enemy within 4 cells, 10 × arcane power poison damage. Cooldown 5 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Mending.label: mending
LanguageData.LP_WS_Mending.description: Cantrip (Transmutation): channel for 5 seconds to mend an item within 6 cells (10% durability) or a building (50 × arcane power hit points).
LanguageData.LP_WS_Prestidigitation.label: prestidigitation
LanguageData.LP_WS_Prestidigitation.description: Cantrip (Transmutation): pick a cell within 10 cells: clear all filth within radius 3; if the chosen cell is a meal (or has a meal on it), make it fresh again.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Light.label: light
LanguageData.LP_WS_Light.description: Cantrip (Evocation): place a floating orb of light on a cell within 15 cells, lighting radius 6 for 12 hours, no fuel needed.
LanguageData.LP_WS_MageHand.label: mage hand
LanguageData.LP_WS_MageHand.description: Cantrip (Conjuration): a spectral hand brings an item of up to 10 kg within 15 cells to your side.
LanguageData.LP_WS_FogCloud.label: fog cloud
LanguageData.LP_WS_FogCloud.description: Circle 1 (Conjuration, upcastable): a thick fog of radius 4 billows at a point within 20 cells (vanilla smoke, blocks sight and makes shots hard to land), dispersing after about 30 seconds. Upcast: +1 radius per extra circle.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Grease.label: grease
LanguageData.LP_WS_Grease.description: Circle 1 (Conjuration): coat the ground in radius 2 within 20 cells with grease for 1 minute: enemies inside have a 50% chance each second to slip (stunned 2 seconds). The grease can catch fire.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Thunderwave.label: thunderwave
LanguageData.LP_WS_Thunderwave.description: Circle 1 (Evocation, upcastable): thunder bursts out in radius 3 around yourself; enemies take 12 × arcane power blunt damage and are knocked back 2 cells. Upcast: +25% damage per extra circle.
LanguageData.LP_WS_FalseLife.label: false life
LanguageData.LP_WS_FalseLife.description: Circle 1 (Necromancy): for 1 hour an extra necrotic shield covers you, absorbing 15 × arcane power damage first (same layer as Shield, doesn't stack).
LanguageData.LP_WS_FindFamiliar.label: find familiar
LanguageData.LP_WS_FindFamiliar.description: Circle 1 (Conjuration, ritual): summon a bound familiar (choose a black cat or rat in the window; with DND beasts batch 3 enabled, also a tressym or pseudodragon; it joins the colony and takes the caster as its master). While the familiar lives, research speed ×1.05; spell range +3 while the familiar is within 10 cells. Only one at a time; after the familiar dies, it can be resummoned after 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Alarm.label: alarm
LanguageData.LP_WS_Alarm.description: Circle 1 (Abjuration, ritual): set an alarm in radius 10 around yourself for 1 day: when an enemy enters, a letter warns you and the caster is woken.
LanguageData.LP_WS_ComprehendLanguages.label: comprehend languages
LanguageData.LP_WS_ComprehendLanguages.description: Circle 1 (Divination, ritual): for 1 day, trade prices +5%, negotiation ability ×1.2 (faster persuading and recruiting).
LanguageData.LP_WS_DetectMagic.label: detect magic
LanguageData.LP_WS_DetectMagic.description: Circle 1 (Divination, ritual): for 1 hour see through invisible enemies within 30 cells; on casting, a letter lists the magic items and legendary-quality items on this map.
LanguageData.LP_WS_ScorchingRay.label: scorching ray
LanguageData.LP_WS_ScorchingRay.description: Circle 2 (Evocation, upcastable): fire 3 scorching rays, each 8 × arcane power fire damage; the first hits the chosen enemy, the rest are split among other enemies within 5 cells of it (all hit it if there are no others). Upcast: +1 ray per extra circle.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Shatter.label: shatter
LanguageData.LP_WS_Shatter.description: Circle 2 (Evocation): a piercing burst of sound at a point within 20 cells; enemies and enemy buildings within radius 2 take 14 × arcane power blunt damage; ×2 against mechanoids, buildings and statue-like (non-flesh) targets.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Web.label: web
LanguageData.LP_WS_Web.description: Circle 2 (Conjuration): fill radius 2 within 20 cells with webs for 1 minute: enemies entering have a 60% chance to be stuck for 4 seconds (at most once per person every 5 seconds). The webs catch fire easily.
LanguageData.LP_WS_HoldPerson.label: hold person
LanguageData.LP_WS_HoldPerson.description: Circle 2 (Enchantment, upcastable): one humanlike enemy within 20 cells has a 55% chance to be held (paralyzed 6 seconds); -5% per level the target is above the caster (minimum 10%), halved against legendary creatures and story bosses. Upcast: each extra circle holds another humanlike enemy within 6 cells of it.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Invisibility.label: invisibility
LanguageData.LP_WS_Invisibility.description: Circle 2 (Illusion): one ally within 20 cells turns invisible for 1 hour; attacking or casting reveals them.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Darkness.label: darkness
LanguageData.LP_WS_Darkness.description: Circle 2 (Conjuration): radius 3 at a point within 20 cells is swallowed by magical darkness for 30 seconds: enemies inside have sharply reduced ranged accuracy (same as the warlock's Darkness).
LanguageData.LP_WS_MindSpike.label: mind spike
LanguageData.LP_WS_MindSpike.description: Circle 2 (Divination): one enemy within 24 cells takes 12 × arcane power psychic damage (ignores armor); afterwards it can't turn invisible for 1 hour.
LanguageData.LP_WS_EnhanceAbility.label: enhance ability
LanguageData.LP_WS_EnhanceAbility.description: Circle 2 (Transmutation): one ally within 20 cells for 1 hour, choose one of four in a window: Strength (carry capacity ×1.5, mining ×1.3) / Dexterity (melee dodge +10) / Intelligence (research ×1.2) / Charisma (social impact ×1.2).
LanguageData.LP_WS_ArcaneLock.label: arcane lock
LanguageData.LP_WS_ArcaneLock.description: Circle 2 (Abjuration, ritual): lock a door within 10 cells: damage taken ÷3 (durability ×3, enemy time to break the door ×3), until dispelled (select the door and click "dispel arcane lock").
LanguageData.LP_WS_Knock.label: knock
LanguageData.LP_WS_Knock.description: Circle 2 (Transmutation): within 15 cells: open an ancient sealed container or cryptosleep casket, instantly crack something that needs hacking, or shatter someone else's door.
LanguageData.LP_WS_DispelMagic.label: dispel magic
LanguageData.LP_WS_DispelMagic.description: Circle 3 (Abjuration): one target within 20 cells. Enemy: removes magical buffs (timed buffs and shields from spells and class abilities); ally: removes harmful magical effects such as curses, charm, sleep, hold, petrification and darkness (see the report for the list).
LanguageData.LP_WS_Fly.label: fly
LanguageData.LP_WS_Fly.description: Circle 3 (Transmutation): one ally within 20 cells flies for 1 hour: movement ×1.6, mud, shallow water, snow and plants no longer slow them.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Fear.label: fear
LanguageData.LP_WS_Fear.description: Circle 3 (Illusion): project an 8-cell terrifying illusion in one direction (a cone); each humanlike enemy inside has a 55% chance to flee in terror for 10 seconds; -5% per level the target is above the caster (minimum 10%), halved against legendary creatures and story bosses.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Slow.label: slow
LanguageData.LP_WS_Slow.description: Circle 3 (Transmutation, concentration): up to 6 enemies within radius 3 at a point within 20 cells, each with a 60% chance: movement ×0.5 and attack cooldown ×1.5 for 1 minute (-5% per level the target is above the caster, minimum 10%; halved against legendary creatures and story bosses). Ends early if the caster loses concentration.
LanguageData.LP_WS_StinkingCloud.label: stinking cloud
LanguageData.LP_WS_StinkingCloud.description: Circle 3 (Conjuration): a foul poisonous cloud of radius 3 at a point within 20 cells for 20 seconds: enemies inside have a 50% chance every 2 seconds to vomit (stunned 1.5 seconds).
LanguageData.LP_WS_VampiricTouch.label: vampiric touch
LanguageData.LP_WS_VampiricTouch.description: Circle 3 (Necromancy, concentration): a melee hit for 15 × arcane power necrotic damage, healing yourself for half the damage dealt. For 1 minute after casting (while concentrating), recasting costs no mana with a 2-second cooldown.
LanguageData.LP_WS_AnimateDead.label: animate dead
LanguageData.LP_WS_AnimateDead.description: Circle 3 (Necromancy, upcastable): raise a humanlike corpse within 10 cells as a skeleton servant for 1 day (a lich's skeleton servant that falls apart when time is up). Upcast: each extra circle raises another corpse within 5 cells.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Blink.label: blink
LanguageData.LP_WS_Blink.description: Circle 3 (Transmutation): flicker between planes for 1 minute: each enemy attack has a 50% chance to miss.
LanguageData.LP_WS_ProtectionFromEnergy.label: protection from energy
LanguageData.LP_WS_ProtectionFromEnergy.description: Circle 3 (Abjuration): one ally within 20 cells for 1 hour; choose one of fire / cold / lightning / acid / psychic in the window, and damage of that type taken ×0.5.
LanguageData.LP_WS_MagicCircle.label: magic circle
LanguageData.LP_WS_MagicCircle.description: Circle 3 (Abjuration, ritual): draw a circle of radius 3 around yourself for 1 day; choose one type in the window: demons and devils / undead / elementals / fey: hostile creatures of that type can't enter (they're pushed out if they do), and allies inside take ×0.5 damage from them.
LanguageData.LP_WS_SpeakWithDead.label: speak with dead
LanguageData.LP_WS_SpeakWithDead.description: Circle 3 (Necromancy, ritual): question a humanlike corpse of an enemy faction within 5 cells, choosing one of two in the window: reveal one of that faction's settlements, or gain 200 × arcane power research (once per corpse).
LanguageData.LP_WS_Sending.label: sending
LanguageData.LP_WS_Sending.description: Circle 3 (Divination, ritual): without a comms console, pick a faction in the window and talk to its leader (opens the vanilla comms dialog). Once per day.
